description: This file defines the TransactionManagerJndi class, which models the <transaction-manager-jndi> XML element used in entity configuration. It parses attributes from an XML Element and provides accessors for JNDI server name and JNDI name.

classes.name: TransactionManagerJndi
classes.description: A model object representing the <transaction-manager-jndi> element in the configuration XML, encapsulating JNDI details with validation.

methods.name: TransactionManagerJndi
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by parsing the required attributes from an XML Element, throwing exception if attributes are missing or empty.
